title: A clearer path for GSoC contributors
summary:
A little GSoC housekeeping: clearer application guidance, corrected mentor details and a chatbot adjustment.

The GSoC 2026 README and contributor guide now point applicants to project ideas, mentors, proposal guidance and the official application website. The guide also lists the March 16 application opening and May 25 coding start.

The GSoC timeline now points to the February 19 accepted-organizations announcement, and a mentor’s contact address was corrected in the public listing.

The GSoC site’s chatbot now requests `gemini-fast` instead of `openai` and shows a processing message while it responds.
